productIdentity: Bitcoin/Counterparty XCP wallet, market terminal and W.O.M.E. interface for the NEO System
securityRules: Never request, store, log, transmit, or hard-code private keys, seed phrases, mnemonics, or WIF secrets.
Do not simulate successful transaction execution.
Do not guess production broadcast endpoints.
Require explicit authorization for state-changing financial actions.
Keep observation, composition, signing, broadcast, and confirmation as distinct states.
Represent missing or unverifiable blockchain data as unavailable rather than fabricated.
Fail closed when signing, identity, authorization, endpoint, or network state is uncertain.

currentInfrastructureGate.interpretation: Cloudflare account/object resolution failure before Worker deployment; verify Account ID and API token belong to the same authorized account and Workers scope.

neoAlgo.role: consume and reason over normalized wallet, asset, market, order, trade, economics, transaction and authorization-state signals
constraints: distinguish on-chain facts from calculated and estimated values
distinguish intent from unsigned, signed, broadcast and confirmed states

neoOracle.role: provenance-bearing Bitcoin/Counterparty state and external-data verification
constraints: preserve source and timestamp/block context when available
label direct, derived, estimated and unavailable values

gissNeoLms.role: applied curriculum for Bitcoin, Counterparty, wallet security, signing, broadcasting, API gateways, provenance and fail-closed financial architecture

neoSync.role: orchestrate authorized reads, health checks, summaries, transaction preparation, execution gates, deployment diagnostics and audit records
constraints: never silently escalate review state into execution

neoLaw.role: internal rules for consent, authorization, custody, signing authority, auditability, asset representations, recordkeeping and disclosure
neoLaw.constraint: internal doctrine does not substitute for applicable external law or regulation

norms: no fake balances, trades, confirmations or broadcasts
explicit authorization before state-changing financial actions

neoRouter.role: route read, analyze, compose, sign-request, broadcast-request, confirmation, audit and error operation classes through appropriate authorization gates

neoLingo.role: normalize wallet, address, asset, balance, transaction, order, order match, dispenser, compose, signer, unsigned/signed transaction, broadcast, confirmation, custody, Counterparty, XCP, NOMNI and W.O.M.E. terminology

neoInvestments.role: consume verified NEOpay ledger and market state for authorized Bitcoin-native investment and capital-markets workflows

neoDigitalCapital.role: use NEOpay as an approved wallet/market interface without weakening custody, legal, or provenance controls

familyOffice.role: treasury and portfolio consumption of verified NEOpay data subject to authorization and applicable legal/compliance boundaries

productionReadinessGates: Cloudflare Worker successfully deployed to correct authorized account
frontend points to verified Worker API base
production broadcast route verified from authoritative Counterparty behavior/documentation
end-to-end execution verified without exposing custody secrets
supersessionRule: This record remains authoritative until an explicit later canonical NEO System decision supersedes it.
